content: Solo homelab secrets: SOPS v3.13.2 + age recommended — one age key, files decryptable anywhere, not k8s-specific; ArgoCD needs KSOPS or helm-secrets plugin. sealed-secrets simplest controller-native option but cluster-key-bound (bad for disposable clusters — losing controller key loses all secrets). ESO overkill without an external secret manager. Hybrid: SOPS for bootstrap, controller later if needed.
